value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(door_open) is redundant. Hard Existence(target_picked_up) with hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) already forces the door to open. Remove Existence(door_open); keep the other clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up)` adds an order the task does not state; “Open the door and pick up the box” commands both events but does not say “then” or “before.” Replace that clause with a hard `Existence(door_open)` to require opening the door without adding an order. Keep the hard `Existence(target_picked_up)`. The environment’s constraints do not justify adding an unstated clause.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task requires opening the door and picking up the box; both are required by hard Existence clauses.
